# lumos Provider

Lumos API (v1): ALPHA: the 1.x line targets the Lumos V1 API and may introduce breaking changes without prior notice. Pin an exact version. For production, stay on 0.x (version = "~> 0.10").

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    lumos = {
      source  = "teamlumos/lumos"
      version = "1.0.0-alpha.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "lumos" {
  server_url = "..." # Optional
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `http_bearer` (String, Sensitive) HTTP Bearer. Configurable via environment variable `LUMOS_ACCESS_TOKEN`.
- `server_url` (String) Server URL (defaults to https://api.lumos.com)
